games.title: Benny's Sphere Splash
games.description: An underwater team sport played inside a giant floating sphere of water. Your team of six swims on its own, and play stops every time there is a choice to make: pass, shoot or dribble with the ball, and tackle or block on defense. Every choice shows its odds, and nothing is ever on a timer. Change formation from the Huddle, pick a difficulty, and hear a full broadcast crew call the match. Created by Bryan R. (Ben’s other big brother), working in collaboration with NARBE LLC.

games.title: Chasing Rainbows
games.description: Inclusive Imagination®’s weather card game, played with one or two switches. Choose Chasing Rainbows Full or Lite, or Rainbow Race Full or Lite. Play against computer opponents or share the switch with family. Everything is spoken and nothing is timed.

games.title: NARBE Racer
games.description: Pick your racer and vehicle, then race sixteen tracks across four cups, with loop-de-loops, banked turns, drive-through waterfalls and a big jump over a different landscape on every track. Race for trophies in Grand Prix, tackle a single race, or beat the clock in Time Trial. Automatic acceleration and one- or two-switch controls keep you in the race, with a two-player mode using one switch each.

games.title: Benny's Ballista
games.description: Topple castles in three story campaigns, or create your own castles and full campaigns in the Castle Workshop. Build ordered levels with custom stories and goals, then save, play and share your adventures. Play with one or two switches; the Workshop uses a mouse and keyboard.

games.title: Benny Says
games.description: A simon says style game where you need to match the growing sequence every round

games.title: Benny's Baseball
games.description: A full baseball simluation game with no reaction needed, simply make choices and play a full season of baseball.

games.title: Benny's Basketball Shooter
games.description: Shoot hoops in a packed arena. Chase a high score in the 12-shot Shootout (a perfect game unlocks sudden-death bonus shots), or play HORSE with a friend: pick a spot and make shots they have to match. Audio cues help you aim and time each shot.

games.title: Benny's Football
games.description: Pick your team color and play a 16-game season of football! Call your plays, time your passes, and win 10 games to make the single-elimination playoffs - or go 16-0 for a straight shot at the championship.

games.title: Robot Football
games.description: Lead your robot team in 3D football with one or two switches. Call plays, pass, run, and defend in practice, exhibition games, or a 16-game season. Spoken guidance, adjustable pace, and optional scan-and-select movement let you play your way.

games.title: Benny's Battle Boats
games.description: A classic battleship-style game where you place your fleet and try to sink the enemy's ships. Play against the computer or challenge a friend in 2-player mode!

games.title: Benny's Bowling
games.description: Bowling with real physics on a full alley. Hot-seat up to 4 players, each with their own ball and scoresheet. Audio cues let you charge and aim the shot by ear. Ten alley themes.

games.title: Benny's Bug Blaster
games.description: A tower defense style game where you squash bugs with your boot and have to buy items to keep your defenses up against the bugs.

games.title: Benny's Chess and Checkers
games.description: Play classic Chess or Checkers against the computer or with a friend!

games.title: Benny's Connect Four
games.description: Drop pieces and connect four in a row to win! Play against the computer or challenge a friend.

games.title: Benny's Matchy Match
games.description: Previously called concentration. A fun matching game with competitive modes and cooperative play. This comes with an editor app to make your own games!

games.title: Benny's P3GL Game
games.description: A glowing 3D peg shooter you play with one or two switches. Pick a mood: Cozy for relaxed play that never runs out of balls, Vivid for a steady climb, or Hyper for a wild neon space ride. Nine campaigns, 180 levels, powers, hazards, moving pegs, and a Campaign Editor for building your own.

games.title: Benny's Tic Tac Toe
games.description: Play tic tac toe against the computer or against your friends.

games.title: Benny's Dice
games.description: A 3D dice game with Free Throw, Yarkle, and Fahtzee modes. Roll dice with realistic physics!

games.title: Benny's Word Jumble
games.description: A word puzzle game where you have to rearrange the word to advance.

games.title: Elouise's Word Search
games.description: Hunt hidden words in a letter grid, one switch at a time. Pick a row, pick a letter, spin the aimer to point the way the word runs, then stretch it out. Words hide sideways, diagonally and backwards. Thirteen categories with over 1500 words, three difficulty levels, and an editor to build your own word lists.

games.title: Trivia Master
games.description: A trivia game engine that lets you build your own trivia games! Add pictures and videos to make it more fun!

games.title: Benny's Mega Slot
games.description: A fun casino-style slot machine game with bonus modes, multiple themes, and exciting sound effects!

games.title: NARBE Robot Pickleball
games.description: First-person robot pickleball with aimed serves and automatic returns. Play with one or two switches, tap without holding, or use mouse and touch. Choose full speed, slow motion or score-free no-fail play. In collaboration with SCSU and Lily Flack; redesigned and developed by NARBE.

games.title: Benny's Show n Sound
games.description: A spinning wheel See 'n Say. Pick a category, spin the wheel, and hear each panel's name and sound when it lands.

games.title: Benny's Race Tracks
games.description: A 3D racing game you steer with a single switch - the game tells you which way to go with arrows, sound, and speech. Race 10 levels in a car, motorcycle, or spaceship, or pick the no-fail Cruise mode and just collect things along the way.

games.title: NARBE Animal Friends
games.description: A colourful barnyard peekaboo game - press a switch and the barn doors swing open as an animal steps out to say hello. No score, no timer, no losing.

games.title: Benny's Fish Mystery
games.description: A pilot game exploring fishing adventures with one- and two-switch access. Tag fish for Walt's research station, work up from a hand net to a motorboat, and uncover the mystery at the middle of the lake.

games.title: NARBE Mini Golf
games.description: 3D mini golf you play with one or two switches. Three themed 18-hole courses (54 holes) grow from friendly greens into longer winding routes, with roomy bridges, gentle hills and optional shortcuts. Includes up to four players, cinematic replays and a Course Creator.

games.title: NARBE Pet Pals
games.description: Adopt a puppy or a kitten from the rescue and watch it grow up with you, from a baby to a teen, a grown-up and one day a wise senior. Feed, play, cuddle, bathe and nap, go on walks and adventures, and hear real barks, whines, meows and purrs. Care stars unlock outfits, tricks, toys and new things for your home: change the curtains, hang a photo from your album and move the furniture around. Two switches do all of it, every screen fits without scrolling, and a short pause after each choice keeps a double press from doing anything by accident.

games.title: NARBE Magic Button
games.description: Press your switch and make magic! Launch fireworks over a moonlit city, blow shimmery bubbles under the sea, or grow a garden of smiley flowers that ends in a breeze of petals. Every press makes something happen right away, with lots of different sounds so it never gets old. Any switch, key, tap or game controller button works. There is no score, no timer and nothing to lose.

games.title: Glow Pop
games.description: Pop a glowing ball, ladybug or bee into colorful sparkles with a switch, key or tap. Choose colors, sizes, sounds and three ways to play. No score, no timer and nothing to lose. Created by Nancy.

games.title: Switch Stories
games.description: Explore illustrated stories created and adapted for switch users. Read at your own pace and press your switch to bring each page to life with a cause-and-effect animation. Includes read-aloud, adjustable text sizes, and a simple high-contrast view. Created by Nancy.
